# anchored summary (auto-generated)

## Objective
- Expand and maintain the Rio Verde Concurso question bank (Analista Administrativo, Câmara Municipal de Rio Verde) — currently 228 questions (19 per area), with reviewed/corrected content.

## Important Details
- 12 areas from `meta.areas`; inline data in `index.html` synced from `questoes.json`.
- After adding or correcting questions: `questoes.json` updated, `node gerar-paginas.js` regenerates individual pages, inline data in `index.html` rebuilt from the JSON.
- `loadData()` in `script.js` reads `window.__QUESTOES_DATA__.questoes`.
- **Sync `index.html`**: replace the full `<script>` block (from `<script>` to `</script>`) containing `window.__QUESTOES_DATA__`. Do NOT use `indexOf(';')` — use `</script>` as the delimiter since the JSON contains `;` inside HTML entities (`&lt;`, `&amp;`, etc.).
